Body.Content:
Now generally available for both Linux and Windows containers, Azure Container Instances is the easiest and fastest way to run containers on Azure without managing servers. Develop apps quickly without managing virtual machines (VMs) or having to learn new tools.

Container Instances is also now available in the West US, West US 2, East US, West Europe, North Europe, and Southeast Asia regions. Starting July 1, 2018, the global GUIDs will be split out into regional GUIDs. There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on resource GUIDs. See the tables below for GUID migration details.
